cli.statements_head.one: {case}: {n} code, short ids S1 to S{n}
cli.statements_head.other: {case}: {n} codes, short ids S1 to S{n}

cli.gets_history.one: The themes board {name}'s History, newest first: {n} revision.
cli.gets_history.other: The themes board {name}'s History, newest first: {n} revisions.

cli.gets_revision: The themes board {name}'s revision {id} of {when}. Restore makes it the board.
cli.gets_revision_named: The themes board {name}'s revision {id} of {when}, {called}. Restore makes it the board.
cli.gets.take_none: Nothing has changed in {name}'s codes since they came in. Nothing was written.
cli.gets.take_dry: Dry run, nothing was written. It would bring {name}'s changes into every themes board:
cli.gets.take: Brought {name}'s changes into every themes board. Each board kept a revision first, "Before {name}'s changes came in", so Restore puts it back.
cli.gets.take_copy: The copy: codes added {pa}, renamed {pr}, removed {pg}; extracts added {sa}, changed {sc}, moved {sm}, removed {sg}.
cli.gets.take_marked: The codes were marked complete since.
cli.gets.take_board: On {board}: {labels} changed {nl}{keys_l}, cards changed {nc}, cards no longer in the copy {nlost}{keys_lost}, key quotes changed {ncells}{keys_cells}, cards added {nadded}, cards moved down to make room {nmoved}, {labels} moved down {nlm}, sticky notes moved down {nnm}. A code's new extracts join it where it stands. The {labels} and their titles stay as they are.
cli.gets.fresh_dry: Dry run, nothing was written. It would make the themes board {name} with every card in the pile and put it on the canvas.
cli.gets.fresh: Made the themes board {name} with every card in the pile. It is the board on the canvas, and the other boards are as before.
cli.gets.duplicate_dry: Dry run, nothing was written. It would copy the themes board {name} as {copy} and put it on the canvas.
cli.gets.duplicate: Copied the themes board {name} as {copy}, which is now on the canvas. {name} is as it was.
cli.gets.rename_same: The themes board {name} is called that already. Nothing was written.
cli.gets.rename_dry: Dry run, nothing was written. It would rename the themes board {name} as {wanted}.
cli.gets.rename: Renamed the themes board {name} as {wanted}. It is recorded in its History, as "{kept}".
cli.gets.note_same: The themes board {name}'s note reads that already. Nothing was written.
cli.gets.note_off_dry: Dry run, nothing was written. It would take the themes board {name}'s note off.
cli.gets.note_set_dry: Dry run, nothing was written. It would set the themes board {name}'s note to "{words}".
cli.gets.note_off: Took the themes board {name}'s note off. It is recorded in its History, as "{kept}".
cli.gets.note_set: Set the themes board {name}'s note to "{words}". It is recorded in its History, as "{kept}".
cli.gets.canvas_same: The themes board {name} is on the canvas already. Nothing was written.
cli.gets.canvas_dry: Dry run, nothing was written. It would put the themes board {name} on the canvas, in place of {was}.
cli.gets.canvas: The themes board {name} is now on the canvas, in place of {was}. Nothing on any board changed.
cli.gets.current_same: The themes board {name} is the Current board already. Nothing was written.
cli.gets.current_dry: Dry run, nothing was written. It would mark the themes board {name} as the Current board.
cli.gets.current_dry_instead: Dry run, nothing was written. It would mark the themes board {name} as the Current board, in place of {before}.
cli.gets.current: The themes board {name} is now the Current board. It is recorded in its History, as "{kept}".
cli.gets.current_instead: The themes board {name} is now the Current board, in place of {before}. It is recorded in its History, as "{kept}".
cli.gets.delete_dry: Dry run, nothing was written. It would delete the themes board {name}{was} after keeping a copy of it in _Archive.
cli.gets.delete: Deleted the themes board {name}{was}. A copy of it as it stood, with its History, is in _Archive as {file}.
cli.gets.revision_dry: Dry run, nothing was written. It would keep the themes board {name} as it stands in its History, as "{called}".
cli.gets.revision: Kept the themes board {name} as it stands in its History, as "{called}". Nothing on the board changed.
cli.gets.restore_dry: Dry run, nothing was written. It would make the themes board {name}'s revision of {when} the board. It would first keep the board as it stands in its History, as "{kept}".
cli.gets.restore: Restored the themes board {name}'s revision of {when}. The board as it stood is kept first in its History, as "{kept}", so Restore puts it back.
cli.import_raw.wrote_the_participants_wo: Wrote {shown}, the participant's workbook, from {name}, for {case}. It opens on Coding.
cli.import_raw.dry_run_nothing_was_writt: Dry run, nothing was written. It would write {shown}, the participant's workbook, from {name}, for {case}. It would open on Coding.
cli.turn_trim.dry_run_nothing_was_writte: Dry run, nothing was written. {case}, {sheet}: it would cut {span}{times}, {rows}, {marked} of them with a code, a note, an extract or a highlight, leaving {rows2}.
cli.turn_write.the_boards_could_not_be_r: The boards could not be read, so their cards were not moved with the codes: {exc}
cli.turn_write.the_quote_is_not_in_the: The extract {quoted} is not in the turn's words as they stand.
cli.turn_write.the_turns_quotes_go_with_: The turn's extracts go with its codes by place, and {statements} would leave its {quotes} unpaired. Send the extracts with them, or pairs.
cli.turn_write.for_a_statement_and_its_q: {quotes} for {statements}. A code and its extract go by place: give one extract a code, an empty one for a code with none, or send pairs.
cli.turn_write.that_turn_is_the_intervie: That turn is the interviewer's, and codes, notes and extracts belong to the participant's turns. If one was left on it, it can only be taken off with remove. Give a code by its key and a lone extract by its words.
cli.turn_write.remove_key_or_pairs: A code's key under remove takes it off on its own. Send the key alone, or the passage's pairs without that code, not both.
cli.turn_write.the_file_names_no_stateme: The file names no codes, notes or extracts, so there is nothing to write.
cli.said.not_lone: is not a lone extract of this turn, so there is nothing of that to remove.
cli.said.not_this_line: is not the key of a code of this passage. Send each pair's key as turn show gives it, or none.
cli.said.key_twice: is sent for two pairs. Each code of the passage is one pair at most.
cli.effect_lines.the_turns_with_no_state: {verb} the turn's {quotes}, with no code of {v_} own, as {v_2}:
cli.card_lines.on_the_card_its_statement: On {name}, the card {key_} '{text}' {went}, its code removed.
cli.card_lines.on_the_card_where_its_sta: On {name}, the card {from_} '{text}' {went} {to}, where its code now is.
cli.quote_refusal.the_quote_skips_the_pa: The extract {said} skips the passage at row {row}. An extract can take in only the same speaker's passages next to its own, one after another, with only the interviewer's turns between them.
cli.quote_refusal.the_quote_takes_words_: The extract {said} takes words from another speaker's passage at row {row}. An extract holds only one speaker's words.

The extract {said} takes words from row {row}, which is not next to this passage. An extract can take in only the same speaker's passages next to its own, with only the interviewer's turns between them.
The extract {said} takes words from the interviewer's turn at row {row}. An extract holds only the participant's words.
cli.gets_subs.added_to_the_gets_board_ea: Added {cards} to the themes board {name}, each in the nearest free spot. {kept_line}
cli.gets_subs.dry_run_nothing_was_writte: Dry run, nothing was written. It would add {cards} to the themes board {name}, each in the nearest free spot:
cli.gets_complete.dry_run_nothing_was_wr: Dry run, nothing was written. It would reopen the themes, marked complete since {when}.
Dry run, nothing was written. It would mark the themes complete on {get}.
cli.gets_complete.gets_are_not_marked_co: The themes are not marked complete. Nothing was written.
cli.gets_complete.gets_are_marked_comple: The themes are marked complete already, since {when}, on {get}. Nothing was written.
cli.changes_lines.the_copy_differs_in_a_: The copy differs in a code's words, a note or a pick.
cli.gets_apply.dry_run_nothing_was_writt: Dry run, nothing was written. On the themes board {name} it would have: {v_}
cli.gets_apply.arranged_in_no_get_by_par: arranged {cards} in no theme by participant, a row each for {listed}, below the themes, which stay where they are
cli.gets_apply.nothing_to_change_every_p: Nothing to change. Every code and subtheme on {name} is in a theme or set aside, so nothing was written.
cli.gets_apply.operation_arranges_by_giv: Operation {n} arranges by {one_line}. Give "by": "participant". A themes board arranges only by participant.
cli.gets_data.this_project_has_no_gets_f: This project has no themes file yet. The first change on the Themes screen makes it.
cli.gets_canvas.this_project_has_no_part: This project has no participants yet, so its themes canvas is empty.
cli.project_boards_in.nothing_else_in_th: Nothing else in the project would change: no code, note, setting or other board.
cli.project_boards_in.most_in_copy_wordi: Most of {from_}'s codes are not in this project, so most come in the copy's wording. To see it beside yours as it was, open the copy as a project of its own: project open-copy with --from-name.
cli.bring_in.loose: brought in {whose} code '{text}' onto the board in no {unit}
cli.bring_in.no_statement: Operation {n} brings in no code. Give "statement" as its card's key from gets show, or as its id or key from statements, such as S12, with its "participant".
cli.bring_in.not_a_statement: Operation {n} names {statement}, which is not one of {whose} codes.
cli.gets_show.shown_twice: Shown twice ({n}), an extract's card whose code's card is on the board too:
cli.turn_skip.nothing: Nothing to mark on {where}: every passage named is decided with no code already.
cli.turn_skip.dry: Dry run, nothing was written. On {where} it would mark {passages} decided with no code, as Skip does: rows {rows}.
cli.turn_skip.done: Marked {passages} on {where} decided with no code, as Skip does: rows {rows}. The workbook is unchanged, and the run's undo puts them back.
cli.turn_skip.already: Already decided with no code, left as they are: {passages}, rows {rows}.
cli.turn_skip.reason_kept: The reason is kept only in this change's line of the record of agents' changes, which Project history's By an agent shows. The app keeps no reason for a passage left with no code.
cli.turn_skip.reason_alone: Every passage named on {where} is decided with no code already and is left as it is. The reason is recorded for {passages}, rows {rows}, only in this change's line of the record of agents' changes, which Project history's By an agent shows.
cli.turn_skip.reason_alone_dry: Dry run, nothing was written. Every passage named on {where} is decided with no code already: it would record the reason for {passages}, rows {rows}, in the record of agents' changes.
